scripts.build: npm run test:chart-scan && npm run test:portfolio && npm run test:offer && next build
scripts.lint:portfolio: eslint components/portfolio-workspace components/PortfolioModernWorkspace.tsx app/portfolio/page.tsx app/portfolio/modern/page.tsx lib/actions/portfolio-cash.ts
scripts.test:portfolio: node --no-warnings scripts/portfolio-reliability-checks.mjs && node --no-warnings scripts/portfolio-workspace-quality-checks.mjs && node --test scripts/stock-chart-interaction-checks.mjs scripts/portfolio-stage-interaction-checks.mjs scripts/portfolio-overview-checks.mjs && npm run lint:portfolio
scripts.test:chart-scan: node --no-warnings --experimental-strip-types --test scripts/chart-scanner-checks.mjs scripts/chart-scenario-checks.mjs scripts/chart-image-checks.mjs scripts/chart-review-checks.mjs scripts/chart-candle-checks.mjs scripts/chart-display-checks.mjs scripts/chart-indicator-checks.mjs && eslint app/api/chart-scan/route.ts components/ChartScannerWorkspace.tsx components/ChartScanPreview.tsx components/ChartScanAnalysis.tsx components/ChartScanCapabilities.tsx lib/chart-scan-candles.ts lib/chart-scan-indicators.ts lib/chart-scan-haptics.ts lib/chart-scanner.ts lib/chart-scanner-prompts.ts lib/chart-scan-scenario.ts lib/chart-scan-coordinates.ts lib/chart-scan-images.ts lib/chart-scan-timeline.ts lib/chart-scan-review.ts lib/chart-scan-vision.ts
scripts.types:gen: supabase gen types typescript --project-id $SUPABASE_PROJECT_ID --schema public > lib/database.types.ts
scripts.types:gen:local: supabase gen types typescript --local --schema public > lib/database.types.ts
scripts.ios:release: CAPACITOR_SERVER_URL= npx cap sync ios && npx cap open ios
